recommendation:
**These schemes serve entirely different purposes and audiences.** 

**Choose CBSE Merit Scholarship if:** You are a single girl student in class 11-12, scored 70%+ in class 10, study in a CBSE school, and your family earns ≤ Rs. 8 lakh/year. This gives you Rs. 1,000/month for living/educational expenses during your studies—no loan to repay.

**Choose Stand-Up India if:** You are 18+ years old, want to START A NEW BUSINESS (not expand an existing one), are a woman of any background OR an SC/ST man, and can approach a bank for a loan of Rs. 10 lakh to Rs. 1 crore. This is a loan you must repay, but includes free business training and mentoring.
